title: Sharing the inspection station during tomorrow’s chip-substrate pilot
titleZh: 明天晶片載板試產的檢測站共用安排
passage:
Subject: Sharing the inspection station during tomorrow’s chip-substrate pilot

Hi team,

From 8:30 to 9:45, the station will run the reference panel, a sample with known marks. The process engineer will check the score during the 9:45 to 10:00 handover. Neither the reference run nor the handover can be booked for pilot work. The station is available for booking from 10:00 to 11:30; that is the only bookable slot with a process engineer on duty. It is available again from 1:00 to 2:30, but only the training technician will be there. Either a production run or a training run takes the full 90 minutes.

Of the two programs, Blue works with the old camera mount and Green with the new one. For tomorrow’s pickup, the pilot panels are already sealed inside carriers that fit only the new camera mount. Transferring the panels into carriers for the old mount would break those seals. We can use the reference results to clear a program for production only if that program scored at least 98 on the reference panel AND an engineer signs off in person before the run begins. The reference panel itself can be mounted either way. This morning Green scored 99; tomorrow’s result, not today’s, is the one that counts.

The customer’s driver leaves at noon whether we have inspection results or not. The driver’s next trip is on Thursday. The customer accepts only unopened panels sealed for that specific trip. Under the customer’s agreement, reopening and resealing the same panels for a later trip is not allowed. Training uses spare panels and doesn’t need a reference score or an engineer, but the training technician needs the station to herself. She offered to “keep the afternoon warm for us.” I’ve added her booking in pencil, not in the green ink we use for customer commitments.

Thanks,
Rina
passageZh:
主旨：明天晶片載板試產的檢測站共用安排

各位好：

明天上午 8:30 至 9:45，檢測站會用帶有已知標記的參考載板做測試。上午 9:45 至 10:00 是交接時段，製程工程師會在這段時間核對分數。參考測試和交接時段都不能預約試產檢測。上午 10:00 至 11:30 是唯一可預約、且有製程工程師值班的時段。下午 1:00 至 2:30 也可以預約，但到時只有負責訓練的技術員在場。無論是生產檢測或訓練，都需要完整的 90 分鐘。

兩套程式中，Blue 適用於舊款相機座，Green 適用於新款相機座。為了讓客戶明天取貨，試產載板已封存在只能裝到新款相機座上的載具內。若將載板換到適用舊款相機座的載具，就會破壞封條。只有在所用程式對參考載板的檢測分數達到至少 98 分，而且工程師在生產檢測開始前親自簽核，才能依參考測試結果核准該程式用於生產。參考載板本身則可裝到任一款相機座。今天上午 Green 得了 99 分，但採計的是明天的成績，不是今天的。

不論檢測結果是否出爐，客戶的司機中午都會離開。司機下次來是週四。客戶只收專為當次取貨封好的載板，而且不能拆封。依照與客戶的協議，不得將同一批載板拆封再重新封好，留到以後取貨。訓練使用備用載板，不必看參考測試成績，也不需要工程師，但技術員要獨占檢測站。她說可以幫忙「讓下午不至於冷下來」。我先用鉛筆記下她的預約，沒用我們記錄對客戶承諾時用的綠色筆。

謝謝，
Rina
